name: Assimp in-memory 3D scene import pipeline
description:
Assimp::Importer::ReadFileFromMemory lets a caller hand a raw byte buffer (untrusted file content) plus a format hint to the library; the Importer wraps the buffer in a MemoryIOSystem, synthesizes a fake filename (magic prefix + hint extension), and forwards to the regular ReadFile() pipeline. That pipeline (a) picks a BaseImporter subclass by extension or by signature-sniffing (CanRead), (b) calls the chosen importer's InternReadFile() which is the actual per-format binary/text parser (OBJ, glTF, FBX, Collada, IFC, Blender, 3DS, PLY, etc.) filling an aiScene from attacker-controlled bytes, (c) runs ScenePreprocessor to normalize/sanity the freshly parsed scene, (d) optionally runs ValidateDSProcess, and (e) runs the full post-processing step pipeline (ApplyPostProcessing) selected by the pFlags bitmask (aiProcess_Triangulate, aiProcess_JoinIdenticalVertices, aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure, aiProcess_OptimizeMeshes, aiProcess_GenNormals, aiProcess_CalcTangentSpace, aiProcess_SplitLargeMeshes, etc.), each of which walks and mutates the newly built scene graph. Because untrusted bytes drive both the format auto-detection and the per-format parser state machines (and then the post-process algorithms that walk attacker-shaped meshes/bones/animations), this whole chain is the primary attack surface for memory-safety bugs in Assimp, making it a prime fuzzing target.
- ReadFileFromMemory: target; wraps pBuffer/pLength in a MemoryIOSystem and a synthetic filename "$$$___magic___$$$.<pHint>", then calls ReadFile() to run format detection, parsing and post-processing; pHint selects which importer gets tried first/most strongly.
- ReadFile(const char*,pFlags): internal file-based sibling invoked by ReadFileFromMemory itself; the real driver of extension/signature-based importer selection (BaseImporter::GetExtensionList/HasExtension/CanRead), scene preprocessing and post-processing dispatch - exercising it directly with on-disk-style paths is a natural variant.
- ApplyPostProcessing: variant/consumer; can be called again on an already-loaded scene with a different pFlags bitmask, independently driving the post-process step pipeline (BaseProcess::IsActive/ExecuteOnScene) without re-parsing, useful to fuzz flag combinations against a fixed parsed scene.
- SetIOHandler: configuration; lets the harness install/replace the IOSystem used for file existence/open/size checks that ReadFile's importer-selection logic depends on (ReadFileFromMemory itself swaps in MemoryIOSystem internally, but callers can preset a custom IOSystem before/after).
- SetPropertyInteger / SetPropertyFloat / SetPropertyString: configuration; sets AI_CONFIG_* properties consumed by BaseImporter::SetupProperties() and individual InternReadFile implementations (e.g. per-format limits, scale, validation toggles), so the fuzz input can select different internal parsing paths in the per-format importers.
- GetOrphanedScene / GetScene: consumer; retrieves the aiScene built from the fuzzed memory buffer so the harness can further traverse/serialize it, exercising scene-graph-walking code beyond the parse+postprocess step.
The input space spans: the raw byte buffer and its length (drives signature detection and every per-format tokenizer/parser), the pHint string (selects/narrows which BaseImporter claims the data, e.g. "obj","fbx","blend","ifc","dae","ply","3ds","sib","assbin"), and pFlags (any combination of the aiProcess_* bitmask constants, which both gates ValidateDSProcess and selects which of the ~20 post-processing BaseProcess subclasses run over the parsed scene).
